mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods of 2-quarter GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and profit pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods of 3-month INDPRO decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 142,500,000 for three consecutive months signals robust labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 142,500,000 and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS > 142,500,000 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods of 2-quarter GDPC1 rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% for three consecutive months combined with a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% and remains there for 3 months AND PAYEMS declines for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS declines for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
